elements_selected.content: Add integration tests for scene chaining to tests/integration.rs. Test: basic 3-scene chain navigation with correct prev/next links and position in built HTML; chain head has no prev and shows 1 of 3; chain tail has no next; non-chain pages have no nav; wikilink syntax in frontmatter resolves correctly; zetl check reports broken chain errors; zetl check reports cycle errors; multi-chain vault works independently. TEST-015-003 through TEST-015-007.
